record.name: Restyla: AI Interior Design
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Restyla restyles the room you already live in.

Photograph it from the doorway, choose a scheme, and see it finished — with your walls, your windows, your doors and your proportions where they were. Drag the slider, or hold the picture, to see the room as it is and check for yourself. That is the whole point: a beautiful room that is not yours is no use to anyone planning a renovation.

FIFTY-FOUR SCHEMES
Quiet Latitude. The Long Afternoon. Chalk & Timber. Evening Petrol. Warehouse Light. Jewel Box. Sunday Linen — and forty-seven more, including three written for a nursery or a child's room.

Each is written as a specification — palette, materials, light, and how the room is composed — rather than as an adjective, because adjectives produce pastiche and specifications produce rooms. Every result names its materials in words, so you can read what it is made of.

OR NOT A SCHEME AT ALL
Bring a picture you like and Restyla takes its colours and its materials, never its layout. Or describe the room you want in your own words — on its own, or on top of a scheme you have already chosen.

SIDE BY SIDE
Run up to three schemes on the same photograph at once and put them on one screen at the same size. Later, in the archive, up to four saved versions of a room can be set beside each other the same way. Choosing is the job; a carousel cannot do it.

CHANGE ONE THING
Clear the clutter. Empty the room. Furnish an empty one. Evening light. Paler walls. One tap each, no style decision, and everything else stays where it is.

WHERE THE MONEY SHOULD GO
Say roughly what you mean to spend and Restyla sets out the shares — the rug, the lighting, the textiles — in proportions of your own figure, worked out on this phone in your own currency. It never puts a price on a result, because it cannot know what a sofa costs where you live.

PROJECTS
Rooms group under a name you choose — a flat, a floor, a client. A project sends as a single PDF: a cover, then one spread per room, today and as it could be at size, with the specification. One thing to hand a builder or an agent.

HOW IT WORKS, AND WHAT LEAVES YOUR PHONE
No account, no login, nothing to remember. Your photograph is sent to our own server, restyled, and sent back. It goes nowhere else. The original is deleted after two hours and the result after twenty-four. Your finished rooms live on this phone only. No analytics service sees your photographs, because the app contains none.

The results are AI visualisations of a real room. They show one possible scheme; they are not photographs of completed work, and nothing in them is quoted or guaranteed.

CREDITS
Your first credit is free, and no card is needed for it. After that one credit is one generation — a restyle, or a single change — and it is spent only when a picture actually arrives: a failure charges nothing. Take a plan of 40 credits a week, or 180 credits a month; or buy a pack of 20, 50, 100 or 150 credits outright, which never renews and never expires. Anything you do not use stays on your balance while your plan is active. A plan renews until you stop it, and you can stop it at any time in your Apple Account settings.

record.name: Revamp AI: Interior Design
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Not sure what's wrong with your room? Point your phone at it. Room Doctor reads the space and tells you exactly what's holding it back — then hands you free fixes to try tonight.

Then pick a style and watch AI redesign the whole room in seconds. No design degree. No expensive consultants. No guesswork.

MEET ROOM DOCTOR — YOUR ROOM, DIAGNOSED

Photograph any room and the AI reads the actual photo, then returns a verdict — good, solid or needs work — grounded in the real objects in it.

• What I noticed: what already works, so you keep it
• What could feel better: findings pinned as numbered markers on your photo — furniture pushed to the walls, one flat lighting layer, an undersized rug, art hung too high, no focal point
• Start here: free changes to make tonight with what you already own — move, group, rotate, swap a bulb — each with the design principle behind it. Heavy pieces are flagged as a two-person job.

Ask Room Doctor to check back later: re-photograph the same corner and it tells you what changed. Every diagnosed room keeps a profile with Diagnosis, Do now and Ideas tabs, and ideas that need a redesign, removal or swap ask before spending a credit.

TRANSFORM ANY ROOM, ANY STYLE

Choose from 190+ curated room designs across Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Mid-Century, Japandi, Coastal, Farmhouse, Luxury, Bohemian, Mediterranean and more — each a photorealistic result that shows exactly what your room could become.

DESIGN YOUR WHOLE HOME, NOT JUST ONE ROOM

Pick a style and carry it through the whole house. Ten complete collections, each covering all 13 rooms — from the kitchen and living room to the basement, garage and patio. The app tracks your progress and suggests what to design next.

WORKS FOR EVERY SPACE

Living room. Bedroom. Kitchen. Bathroom. Home office. Dining room. Kids room. Entryway. Basement. Patio. If you can photograph it, you can redesign it — apartments, houses and offices included.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Take a photo of any room (or pick from your gallery)
2. Choose a design style and color palette
3. Tap Redesign — your transformed room arrives in seconds
4. Compare before and after with a swipe

REARRANGE WHAT YOU ALREADY OWN

New Furniture Layout takes the same photo and rearranges your existing pieces into a smarter layout — no shopping required. Just tap Explore layouts.

REMOVE, REPLACE, REPAINT WITH AI TOUCH-UP

Want to lose a piece of furniture, swap the rug or repaint a wall? Touch-Up is precision AI editing — remove an object and AI reconstructs the space behind it, replace pieces, or repaint a surface edge to edge.

SHOP THE LOOK — YOUR REDESIGN, PRICED

Every redesign comes with a living shopping list: exactly what changed — the new sofa, the repainted walls, the rug that left — with realistic price ranges. Tap any item to find it in stores, tick things off as you buy or DIY them, and keep a list per look to compare budgets.

WALL COLOR & PALETTE VISUALIZER

Preview wall colors and design palettes in your actual room before committing to a single drop of paint.

BUILT-IN AI DESIGN ASSISTANT

Can't decide which style suits your space? Chat with the AI — describe what you're after, like "cozy but minimal," and get style picks, material ideas and real design advice.

ORGANIZE BY PROJECT

Save every experiment and build a mood board room by room. Compare different looks for the same space before committing.

FREE TO START

Free AI designs every day. No credit card. No catch. Credit packs never expire.

Unlike generic image generators, Revamp AI is purpose-built for interior spaces — it understands layout, furniture, lighting, materials and architecture. Results look like professional renderings, because they are.

Whether you're planning a renovation, refreshing one room, or staging a home for sale, Revamp AI gives you the vision to decide with confidence.

Download free and see what your space could become.

Redesign any room in seconds with AI. Snap a photo, pick a style, and get a photorealistic makeover you can actually shop. No designer. No renovation. No guesswork.

Roomify is your AI interior design studio. Restyle a single room, design your whole home in one cohesive look, or turn a 2D floor plan into a 3D render.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Redesign any space: bedroom, living room, kitchen, home office, kids' room, dining, and more
• Choose from 60+ styles: Modern, Scandinavian, Japandi, Minimalist, Industrial, Bohemian, Coastal, Mid-Century, Farmhouse, Art Deco, and many more
• Design your whole home in one look. Set your color palette, flooring, hardware, and lighting once, and every space follows the same design language
• Floor plan to 3D. Upload a 2D floor plan and get a photorealistic top-down render of the space
• Shop the look. Every piece in your redesign is matched to real, buyable furniture from Amazon, IKEA, Wayfair, and more
• See it at night. Tap any photo to generate a night view, shown side by side with the daytime version
• Edit anything. Tap edit on any photo and type the change ("make the curtains blue", "change the flooring to black tile"). Each edit lands on the right photo, not the whole set
• Save your favorites and revisit them anytime

WHY ROOMIFY

• No subscription. Buy credit packs when you need them (12, 35, 100, or 250 credits). Credits never expire
• Real, shoppable furniture. Most AI design apps stop at pretty pictures. Roomify shows you exactly where to buy each item
• Photorealistic results from AI tuned for interior design
• Built for iPhone and iPad. Fast, native, and it notifies you the moment your design is ready

PERFECT FOR

• Anyone moving into a new place
• People who want a fresh look without renovating
• Interior designers prototyping client ideas
• DIYers planning their next refresh
• Anyone who likes to see it before they buy it

HOW IT WORKS

1. Take or upload a photo of any space, or a 2D floor plan
2. Pick a style, or describe your own
3. Get a photorealistic design in seconds
4. Tap any piece to buy it
5. Edit what you want to change, generate a night view, then save and share

3 free credits when you sign up.

Point your camera at any space, choose a style you love, and let Roomzen reimagine it with realistic lighting, materials and furniture. No contractors, no guesswork, no complicated software.

• Take or upload a photo of your room
• Pick a design style and color palette
• Get a photorealistic redesign in seconds
• Refine colors, mood and details until it feels right
